title: 'My Shifts' filters the grid to only the current user's shifts, hiding all other technician rows
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on a desktop browser as a user who appears as a technician row and has at least one shift.
2. Other technicians also have shifts on the visible range.
3. You are on the Schedule page.
custom_steps:
1. In 'Filter and Display', turn ON 'My Shifts'.
2. Look at the grid.
3. Turn it OFF again.
custom_expected:
1. Only shifts assigned to you remain visible; all other technician rows and their shifts are hidden.
2. Turning it off restores the full grid.
3. This is a personal convenience filter only - it does not change what you are permitted to see (default is OFF, everyone's shifts visible).
